transitions.summary: Functional erratum: 'by Tributing the same number of monsters needed for a Tribute Summon (normally 1)' became 'by Tributing 1 monster'. The GOAT script derives the Tribute count from the card's current Level (2 above Level 6, 1 above Level 4/5, otherwise 0) while the modern script hard-codes exactly one Release, so on a Toon Summoned Skull whose Level has been altered the two implementations demand different Tributes; on the printed Level 6 (confirmed from BabelCDB cards.cdb) both require 1.

review.notes: Baseline text is v1 (DB1-EN040, 2004-10-12), an exact match to the goat cdb entry, annotated 'Basically pre errata'; v0 (MRL-073, 2002-09-16) predates it and is not recorded. Most of the script diff is effect renumbering (the GOAT file shifts e1-e7 to e2-e8); reading both files confirms the only behavioural deltas are the two summon-event clones, the Level-derived Tribute count, and EFFECT_FLAG_CANNOT_DISABLE being present on the modern attack-lock registrar but absent in the GOAT one, so a negating effect can switch off the historical card's cannot-attack lock. Conflicting evidence preserved: the modern printed text carries the Archfiend treatment that the modern script does not implement. Data anomaly: the packet's Retro Pack events list tcg-na 2024-08-23 next to tcg-eu 2008-07-08; the earliest_tcg_date used for dating (2008-07-08) is the sane one. No supported period snapshot falls after 2012-09-29, so no intermediate historical implementation is needed for v3-v5 and none is claimed.
